architecture.scope: Repository layout, source contracts, metadata and path integrity; not Unity compilation/import

features.crowd: Eight stable approach lanes, outer orbit and swept personal-space constraints; mixed/all-heavy autonomous scenarios, not native PhysX proof.

rewards.persistence: Two bounded local preference banks, checksum/version validation, per-run GUID and deferred save retry.

features.feedback: Accepted robot hit has core flash/chips and robot voice; rejected contact has no false core-hit confirmation. Breakup uses archetype scale and resets on reuse.

nativeVerification.scope: Actual engine runner with isolated profile, frame/GC capture and functional scenarios. It must be executed locally in licensed Unity.

delivery: Full project opens in a fresh CareProject_V20 folder
Small update installer is based on exact published V19; close Unity and run RepairProject.cmd
Full/Update archives contain current readable docs and standalone regression sources
limits: Unity Editor import/type compilation, native Animator/PhysX, shader compilation, Profiler and mobile/device testing were not run here.
The 3–5 minute target is a design goal; 146.95 seconds is an autonomous instant-kill schedule probe, not measured human playtime.
Windows PowerShell5.1 and .NETFramework were not run. Installer core compiledC#5 and executed on .NET8 against real temporary files.
UI previews rasterize actual GUI commands with a flat backdrop; they are not Unity screenshots.
Progress is local per device; no cloud/account sync or payment integration.
